suites.name: Program policy and evidence roles
suites.basis: canonical policy, typed-record rules and rejected record mutations
positive: only final ZLB acceptance attributed to a person

suites.name: Four-critic semantic calibration
suites.basis: independent formal references, verified transformations and frozen blind challenge rubrics
suites.consumer: reconstruction, coverage, unit semantic and assembled critic consumers

suites.name: Sensitivity and benchmark adequacy
suites.basis: predeclared coverage matrix and verified meaning-preserving transformations

suites.name: Baseline and ambiguity adjudication
suites.basis: complete immutable source-span mapping, concepts, obligations, dependency and protected-object assertions
positive: inapplicable obligation removed with located proof and lineage
suites.consumer: actual inventory freeze, planner and rewrite admission

suites.name: Rewrite, repair and assembly
suites.basis: concept and obligation correspondence plus independent exact-object and byte comparisons
suites.consumer: rewrite, preflight, repair and assembled admission

suites.name: Independent automated reproduction
suites.basis: separate clean execution and independent content, build and evidence verifier

comparison_contracts.exact-content-v1: Default deterministic and simulation content-hash equality
comparison_contracts.qualified-source-fidelity-v1: Preregistered fresh inference: both candidates pass actual qualified source-bound unit/assembled reviews against identical source/baseline/obligations, exact objects and builds; preserve every byte difference and verify every fresh child allocation

positive: fresh environment reproduces frozen artifact content and correspondence

suites.name: Release and final output boundary
suites.basis: immutable candidate identity and typed automatic versus human decision records
positive: intermediate and held-out gates consume automatic results
valid final ZLB human decision permits release after all gates
suites.consumer: actual release validation and decision journal

suites.name: Evidence, invalidation and execution recovery
suites.basis: frozen identities, single-use allocations and exact attempt/evidence multiplicity
suites.consumer: orchestration, runtime admission, phase runner and allocation ledger

gate_exits.V2-G0: authority artifacts agree; R1–R29 and v2 records are specified; v1 cannot satisfy v2 release. Passing G0 establishes specification only.
gate_exits.V2-G1: every schema has valid and invalid examples; rewriting rejects uncovered spans, unresolved classification, dangling dependencies, missing obligations, and invalid exact-object links.
gate_exits.V2-G2: all source spans have dispositions; all substantive concepts pass bidirectional checks; ambiguities are adjudicated; every concept has obligations and a unit assignment; dependencies are acyclic or explicitly resolved.
gate_exits.V2-G3: mutations deleting a concept or qualification, mentioning without explaining, adding unsupported content, using a concept before teaching it, removing unapproved scaffolding, changing an exact object, or truncating output block acceptance.
gate_exits.V2-G4: deterministic semantic mutations are caught or unresolved; every admitted model critic has current automatic calibration using independent reference evidence, blind challenges and automatic sensitivity diagnostics; repair converges without regression or stops with intact parents and a concrete technical disposition.
gate_exits.V2-G5: untouched regions are byte-stable; revised and comparison PDFs build cleanly; every semantic, exact-object, privacy, policy, and assembly gate passes; an independently launched clean environment and verifier reproduce the frozen artifacts with actual execution evidence.
gate_exits.V2-G6: requires V2-G0–V2-G5, automatically verified ZLB and held-out packets, automatic independent reproduction and actual named human reader acceptance of the final immutable ZLB candidate. Only V2-G6 can authorize production/external promotion. Missing human evidence for that final ZLB test cannot be waived; no human intermediate or held-out verdict is required.
